title: Nougatadditons
description: This is a highly customizable mod in development, specificly made for our modpack.
body:
This is a mod that modifies the behaviour of other mods and adds some small things. It adds useful repairkits that  also interact with create deployers. It also adds a different respawn behaviour, giving the possibility to have a maximum number of lives. This also works with hardcore mode.There are more things planned in the future.

The blaze upgrade template from create dragons plus can no longer be found. It is replaced with the empty blaze upgrade template. After obtaining it you have to craft the blaze upgrade template in another process. The blaze upgrade template can no longer be duplicated by crafting.

Repairkits:
- Weaponrepairkit is for swords, axes, tridents and mazes
- Armorrepairkit is for everything tagged with the vanilla armor tags and the vanilla shield
- Bowrepairkit is for bows, crossbows, the vanilla brush and all the vanilla rods
- Toolrepairkit is for pickeaxes, shovels, hoes and the vanilla shears.
